hallucination.reason: No unsubstantiated claims or invented details were found in the agent's responses.

overclaim.reason: The agent correctly stated the terms and conditions without making unwarranted promises or guarantees.

interruption_recovery.reason: The agent successfully navigated the conversation despite initial confusion and got back on track.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its role and knowledge base, avoiding invention of services or comparisons not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: The agent did not receive any out-of-scope requests that required escalation, but when faced with unrelated queries, it politely redirected the conversation.
